EXPLANATION: The dominant Raman band at 2255 cm⁻¹ matches the characteristic ν(C≡N) stretch of a nitrile; only candidate 1 (CCC#CC(C)C#N) contains a nitrile group. The strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2940 and 2888 cm⁻¹ and the CH₂/CH₃ bending bands at 1457/1430 cm⁻¹ are consistent with its alkyl chain. No other candidate offers a nitrile to account for the 2255 cm⁻¹ peak, making candidate 1 the best fit.
